advisoryFindings.title: R5 side-effect assertion is narrow
advisoryFindings.improvement: In the missing non-official plugin test, also assert that no installed plugin directory or configured missing source path is created or modified, not only that `.senti/plugin-sources` is absent.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test covers the main candidate behavior and one expected no-fetch side effect, so R5 is not uncovered, but broader side-effect checks would make the regression protection tighter.
